prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
competitors_mentioned: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews
engine_stated_criteria: Best if you want more ongoing monitoring
answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best single service to check whether ChatGPT and similar AI engines recommend your small business**, the strongest all-around option from the results is **Guzu AI** for a free first check with an immediate action plan, or **HubSpot AI Search Grader** if you want the simplest free baseline from a well-known vendor.[7][2]

A practical way to choose is:

- **Best free baseline:** **HubSpot AI Search Grader** — it checks visibility across **ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini** and is explicitly described as a free one-time diagnostic.[2]
- **Best “check and fix” workflow:** **Guzu AI** — it offers a **free GEO audit** with an instant check across **ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews**, plus a ready-to-use action plan.[7]
- **Best if you want more ongoing monitoring:** **Otterly.AI**, **Semrush AI Visibility**, or **BrandRank.AI** are positioned more as tracking/monitoring tools than one-time checks.[6][14][16]

If your main question is simply, *“Does AI recommend my business?”*, start with **HubSpot AI Search Grader** or **Guzu AI** because they are both oriented around a quick baseline check rather than a heavy subscription.[2][7] If you want, I can also narrow this down by **budget**, **local business type**, or whether you care most about **ChatGPT only** versus **ChatGPT + Gemini + Perplexity**.
